ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an ecological food web diagram. In the lower left of the diagram there is grass labeled “Grass”, and near the grass, slightly above it, there is a cottontail rabbit labeled “Cottontail”. In the diagram there is an arrow from Grass to Cottontail, indicating that the cottontail rabbit eats grass or relies on grass as a food source. Reasoning: The question says that if a grass fire destroyed half of the grass in this ecosystem, then the food supply of the cottontail rabbit would decrease. According to ecological relationships, when a consumer’s food decreases, its population usually declines. Therefore, the number of cottontail rabbits may decrease.
